source.title: Call for Applicants - WMT Team Members (August 2018)
source.content:
The WCA Marketing Team (WMT) is seeking members in order to accomplish its mission. 

The applications are open to everyone; it’s not a requirement to hold a current position in the WCA to be considered. As the selection process of a Leader for the WMT has not been successful, the selection process will be conducted by the WCA Board of Directors as allowed per Section 5.3 of the [WCA Bylaws](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/WCA%20Bylaws.pdf).

**What does the WMT do?**
The WMT is an Advisory Committee of the WCA which is responsible for developing and managing the WCA Brand, seeking sponsorships, supporting the distribution of WCA Competition Gear, and marketing WCA Merchandise. 

**The qualities expected of candidates are:**
     - Marketing background
     - Trustworthiness
     - Social media knowledge
     - Fluent English
     - Communication skills

The rights and duties of the WMT can be seen in [WCA Motion 10.2018.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2018.1%20-%20Marketing%20Team.pdf).

The application period is open for candidates to submit their candidacy document from now until **September 9th, 2018, 23:59 UTC** privately to the WCA Board ([board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)).

**Candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:**
     - A brief personal introduction
     - Summary of activities done for the WCA
     - Ambitions as a member of the WCA Marketing Team

Upon reception it will be confirmed if documents are in good order or if there are deficiencies.

After the application period, the WCA Board will make their selections and the new members will be announced once candidates have accepted the positions.

Thank you for your candidacies and support!

translation.title: WCA 市场推广团队成员招募（2018 年 8 月）
translation.content:
WCA 市场推广团队（WMT）正在招募成员，一起开展团队的工作。

申请面向所有人开放，无须目前已在 WCA 任职。由于 WMT 负责人遴选未能选出人选，此次成员遴选将由 WCA 董事会依照《[WCA 章程](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/WCA%20Bylaws.pdf)》第 5.3 节进行。

**WMT 的工作是什么？**

WMT 是 WCA 的咨询性委员会，负责建设和管理 WCA 品牌、寻求赞助、支持 WCA 比赛器材的分发，以及推广 WCA 周边商品。

**我们希望申请人具备以下条件：**

- 市场推广背景。
- 可靠、值得信任。
- 了解社交媒体。
- 英语流利。
- 良好的沟通能力。

WMT 的权利和职责见 [WCA 决议 10.2018.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2018.1%20-%20Marketing%20Team.pdf)。

申请期为即日起至 **2018 年 9 月 9 日 23:59 UTC**。请将材料私下发送给 WCA 董事会（[board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)）。

**申请材料须为 PDF 格式，包含：**

- 简短的自我介绍。
- 为 WCA 所做工作的总结。
- 担任 WCA 市场推广团队成员的工作设想。

收到材料后，我们会确认材料是否齐全，或说明需要补充之处。

申请期结束后，WCA 董事会将选定人选，并在申请人接受任命后公布新成员。

感谢大家的申请与支持！
